answer: Each submission hangs on the tundra of a task receipt, and the ledge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the relic is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
